2609.01217.title: Prompt-Robust Language Models: Which Training Strategies Work?
2609.01217.paper_summary: Despite their strong performance, large language models remain highly sensitive to prompt formulation. Prior work addresses this through refined data construction or through dedicated robustness objectives. We reproduce and compare these strategies under controlled conditions, and measure how effective they are in addressing models' prompt sensitivity. We find the current robustness fine-tuning methods improve over standard fine-tuning and in-context learning, but the best-to-worst prompt gap remains as high as 40-57% of performance. Moreover, the recent robustness-enhancing methods we test - CoIN for contrastive alignment and PPCL for consistency regularization - often fail to outperform the simplest data construction strategy: training on one template per batch. Our diagnostics explain these results. The auxiliary objectives move the quantity they penalize, but do not generalize beyond it. Additionally, data construction strategies differ due to the conflicting signs of per-template gradients on 57-64% of parameters. Thus, batches that mix formulations force the optimizer to reconcile competing updates instead of finding a shared, prompt-agnostic one.
2609.01217.paper_summary_zh: 儘管大型語言模型表現強勁，但仍對提示的表達方式高度敏感。先前的研究通過精細的數據構建或專門的穩健性目標來解決這一問題。我們在受控條件下重現並比較這些策略，並測量它們在解決模型提示敏感性方面的有效性。我們發現，目前的穩健性微調方法優於標準微調和上下文學習，但最佳與最差提示之間的差距仍高達40-57%的性能。此外，我們測試的近期穩健性增強方法——CoIN用於對比對齊和PPCL用於一致性正則化——往往未能超越最簡單的數據構建策略：每批訓練一個模板。我們的診斷解釋了這些結果。輔助目標移動了它們懲罰的數量，但並未超出這一範疇進行概括。此外，由於每個模板的梯度在57-64%的參數上存在相互矛盾的符號，數據構建策略有所不同。因此，混合不同表達方式的批次迫使優化器調和競爭的更新，而不是找到一個共享的、與提示無關的更新。
2609.01217.author: Frederic Sadrieh et.al.
